temperature_reference: Min–max across valid block surface-temperature summaries in the four-ZIP pilot
traffic_reference: Existing City-of-Plano-referenced nearby traffic-volume index, not a pure distance-to-road measure
weights: Explicit equal weights; not learned from preferences
missing: Any missing required factor gives unknown score
limits: Surface temperature and canopy may be correlated. This is a scenario index, not validated comfort, air temperature or health risk.
